The reusable carafe pod works very well. I used it with the filter and without. With the filter it is an easy clean up. Without the filter, it is difficult to remove the coffee. Sometimes it gets really impacted. Not worth the extra time. Also do not fill the filter too high, it will be difficult to get out, even with the filter. Another thing I do is save the coffee grounds and put them in my garden as nutrient for the soil. I do it with the disposable pods also, then recycle the plastic. With the refillable pod there's no plastic waste.
